from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows/columns are the color that forms full straight lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if sum(x == grid[r][c] for x in grid[r]) == w and
                   sum(grid[i][c] == grid[r][c] for i in range(h)) == h), None)
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    # The symbols inside panels are the non-background, non-divider color.
    colors = {x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda color: sum(x == color for row in grid for x in row))
    marker = next(color for color in colors if color != background)
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        line = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                        for r in range(ra + 1, rb)
                        for c in range(ca + 1, cb))
            line.append(6 if count == 1 else 1 if count >= 2 else 6)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-5603246c.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'), globals())
